caption: The drawing depicts a single, wall-mounted wooden cabinet with a glass-front door. The cabinet has a natural wood grain texture with shades of brown, and features a central, transparent glass panel divided into four sections by thin wooden muntins. The door has a small, round metallic knob on the left side and is hinged on the right. The cabinet is designed to fit into a corner, as indicated by the angled sides and the triangular top and bottom. Both the top and bottom of the cabinet have decorative, symmetrical carvings; the top features a curved, scalloped crest with a round finial at the peak, while the bottom edge has a similarly carved motif with a central rounded extension. The cabinet is depicted against a plain, off-white background.
title: Hanging Corner Cupboard
